ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. Learned advocate for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the present petition with a view to avail alternative remedy under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2. Permission as prayed for is granted.
